user.title: Choose country
user.description:
Pick the country whose electricity tariffs you want to follow.

⚠️ Beta: tariff schedules and prices still need to be confirmed. Always check them against your bill and report errors on GitHub.

data_description.operator: Pick from the list or type your own. Used to name the device and to suggest prices.
data_description.holiday_entity: Only for tariffs where public holidays count as Sunday (e.g. Spain 2.0TD, Italy). Select a sensor that is OFF on non-working days, such as the Workday integration.

price_mode.title: Prices
price_mode.description:
How should the price per kWh for {plan} be set?

Built-in prices: {defaults}

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Price per kWh for each period of {plan}. The fields are pre-filled with the built-in prices when they exist; change only what is different in your contract.

error.cannot_load: Could not load the tariff data for this country.
